name: Our Last Goodbye
source:
You awake to find yourself in an unfamiliar place with no recollection of why or how you got here. All you remember is the friendly face that came to visit, and you're hoping to get answers from them. 

[From [url=https://azufx.itch.io/our-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时发现自己身处一个陌生的地方，不记得为什么或如何来到这里。你所记得的只是前来拜访的那张友好的面孔，你希望从他们那里得到答案。

[来自[url=https://azufx.itch.io/our-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
